source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# Load v2.json as primary source
with open("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/edcr_diagnostic_v2.json") as f:
    v2_data = json.load(f)

# Filter: only individual methods (no summary rows), only evidence-producing (edcr > 0)
methods = {}
for d in v2_data:
    if d.get("is_summary"):
        continue
    name = d["method"]
    if name == "SFT no-evidence":
        continue  # no evidence produced
    methods[name] = {
        "method": name,
        "rel_f1": d["rel_f1"],
        "evi_f1": d["evi_f1"],
        "edcr": d["edcr"],
        "collapsed": d.get("collapsed", False)
    }

# Add CSV entries not in v2.json
import csv
with open("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/edcr_diagnostic_table.csv") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        name = row["Method"]
        if name == "SFT no-evidence":
            continue
        if name not in methods:
            methods[name] = {
                "method": name,
                "rel_f1": float(row["rel_f1"]),
                "evi_f1": float(row["evi_f1"]),
                "edcr": float(row["EDCR"]),
                "collapsed": float(row["rel_f1"]) < 0.01
            }

# Update DPO CED 1ep with fixed version from CSV if available
if "DPO-CED 1ep (fixed)" in methods and "DPO CED 1ep" in methods:
    # CSV has a "fixed" version - replace the collapsed one
    pass  # keep both, they're different entries

data = list(methods.values())
data.sort(key=lambda x: x["rel_f1"], reverse=True)

print("=" * 90)
print(f"{'Method':<30} {'Rel-F1':>8} {'Evi-F1':>8} {'EDCR':>8} {'Collapsed':>10}")
print("-" * 90)
for d in data:
    print(f"{d['method']:<30} {d['rel_f1']:>8.4f} {d['evi_f1']:>8.4f} {d['edcr']:>8.4f} {str(d['collapsed']):>10}")
print(f"\nTotal evidence-producing methods: {len(data)}")

# Define subsets
full = data
no_extreme = [d for d in data if d["rel_f1"] >= 0.05]
no_extreme_no_dpo3ep = [d for d in no_extreme if d["method"] != "DPO CED 3ep"]

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("SUBSET DEFINITIONS")
print("-" * 90)

# Methods with rel_f1 < 0.05 (extreme outliers)
extreme = [d for d in data if d["rel_f1"] < 0.05]
print(f"\nExtreme outliers removed (rel_f1 < 0.05): {len(extreme)}")
for d in extreme:
    print(f"  - {d['method']}: rel_f1={d['rel_f1']:.4f}, edcr={d['edcr']:.4f}")

print(f"\nDPO CED 3ep (also removed in subset c):")
dpo3 = [d for d in data if d["method"] == "DPO CED 3ep"]
for d in dpo3:
    print(f"  - {d['method']}: rel_f1={d['rel_f1']:.4f}, edcr={d['edcr']:.4f}")

# Compute correlations
print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("SPEARMAN CORRELATIONS: EDCR vs Rel-F1")
print("-" * 90)
print(f"{'Subset':<40} {'n':>3} {'rho':>8} {'p-value':>12}")
print("-" * 90)

for name, subset in [("Full set", full), 
                      ("No extreme outliers (rel_f1>=0.05)", no_extreme),
                      ("No extreme + No DPO 3ep", no_extreme_no_dpo3ep)]:
    edcr_vals = [d["edcr"] for d in subset]
    rel_f1_vals = [d["rel_f1"] for d in subset]
    rho, pval = spearmanr(edcr_vals, rel_f1_vals)
    print(f"{name:<40} {len(subset):>3} {rho:>8.4f} {pval:>12.6f}")

# Additional correlations
print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("ADDITIONAL CORRELATIONS (full set)")
print("-" * 90)
print(f"{'Metric pair':<40} {'n':>3} {'rho':>8} {'p-value':>12}")
print("-" * 90)

# EDCR vs Evi-F1
edcr_vals = [d["edcr"] for d in full]
evi_f1_vals = [d["evi_f1"] for d in full]
rel_f1_vals = [d["rel_f1"] for d in full]
rho_ev, pval_ev = spearmanr(edcr_vals, evi_f1_vals)
print(f"{'EDCR vs Evi-F1':<40} {len(full):>3} {rho_ev:>8.4f} {pval_ev:>12.6f}")

# EDCR vs Rel-F1
rho_rf, pval_rf = spearmanr(edcr_vals, rel_f1_vals)
print(f"{'EDCR vs Rel-F1':<40} {len(full):>3} {rho_rf:>8.4f} {pval_rf:>12.6f}")

# (Evi-F1 - Rel-F1) vs EDCR
gaps = [d["evi_f1"] - d["rel_f1"] for d in full]
rho_gap, pval_gap = spearmanr(gaps, edcr_vals)
print(f"{'(Evi-F1 - Rel-F1) vs EDCR':<40} {len(full):>3} {rho_gap:>8.4f} {pval_gap:>12.6f}")

# Also compute on filtered subsets
print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("ADDITIONAL CORRELATIONS (no extreme outliers)")
print("-" * 90)
edcr_ne = [d["edcr"] for d in no_extreme]
evi_ne = [d["evi_f1"] for d in no_extreme]
rel_ne = [d["rel_f1"] for d in no_extreme]
gaps_ne = [d["evi_f1"] - d["rel_f1"] for d in no_extreme]

rho1, p1 = spearmanr(edcr_ne, evi_ne)
print(f"{'EDCR vs Evi-F1':<40} {len(no_extreme):>3} {rho1:>8.4f} {p1:>12.6f}")
rho2, p2 = spearmanr(edcr_ne, rel_ne)
print(f"{'EDCR vs Rel-F1':<40} {len(no_extreme):>3} {rho2:>8.4f} {p2:>12.6f}")
rho3, p3 = spearmanr(gaps_ne, edcr_ne)
print(f"{'(Evi-F1 - Rel-F1) vs EDCR':<40} {len(no_extreme):>3} {rho3:>8.4f} {p3:>12.6f}")

# Print methods in each subset
print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("METHODS IN EACH SUBSET")
print("-" * 90)
for sname, subset in [("Full set", full), 
                       ("No extreme outliers", no_extreme),
                       ("No extreme + No DPO 3ep", no_extreme_no_dpo3ep)]:
    print(f"\n{sname} (n={len(subset)}):")
    for d in subset:
        print(f"  {d['method']:<30} rel_f1={d['rel_f1']:.4f}  evi_f1={d['evi_f1']:.4f}  edcr={d['edcr']:.4f}")

PYEOF

| No extreme + No DPO 3ep | 16 | **-0.9765** | <0.000001 |
